title: GT-Space: Enhancing Heterogeneous Collaborative Perception with Ground Truth Feature Space
abstract: arXiv:2603.19308v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In autonomous driving, multi-agent collaborative perception enhances sensing capabilities by enabling agents to share perceptual data. A key challenge lies in handling {\em heterogeneous} features from agents equipped with different sensing modalities or model architectures, which complicates data fusion. Existing approaches often require retraining encoders or designing interpreter modules for pairwise feature alignment, but these solutions are not scalable in practice. To address this, we propose {\em GT-Space}, a flexible and scalable collaborative perception framework for heterogeneous agents. GT-Space constructs a common feature space from ground-truth labels, providing a unified reference for feature alignment. With this shared space, agents only need a single adapter module to project their features, eliminating the need for pairwise interactions with other agents. translated_title: GT-Space：利用真值特征空间增强异构协同感知
translated_abstract: 在自动驾驶中，多智能体协同感知通过让智能体共享感知数据来增强感知能力。一个关键挑战在于处理来自配备不同传感模态或模型架构的智能体的异构特征，这使得数据融合变得复杂。现有方法通常需要重新训练编码器或设计解释器模块来实现成对特征对齐，但这些方案在实践中缺乏可扩展性。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了GT-Space，一个面向异构智能体的灵活且可扩展的协同感知框架。GT-Space从真值标签构建一个共同特征空间，为特征对齐提供统一的参考。借助这一共享空间，智能体只需一个适配器模块即可投影其特征，从而无需与其他智能体进行成对交互。此外，我们还设计了一个融合网络进行训练……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出GT-Space框架，通过从真值标签构建共同特征空间作为统一对齐参考，使异构智能体仅需单个适配器模块即可完成特征投影与融合，避免了成对交互和编码器重训练，实现了灵活可扩展的异构协同感知。
